scope: privileged GT ROI; functional packet decode; no task or source-denial claims

metric_control.scope: 48-frame native62 historical full-map/crop metrics and exact RGB SSE

metric_definition.full_lpips_standard: standard LPIPS Alex scalar, feature-layer means
metric_definition.crop_lpips: separate 64x64 GT crop, historical spatial-map mean

lpips.pooling: spatial map at full resolution (bilinear), mean over the frame or region

dists.pooling: every layer's mean, variance and covariance weighted by the region resized to it (area)
